description: Source code for a Thread class implementation managing thread creation, control, and lifecycle in a cross-platform manner (Windows and POSIX). It includes thread initialization, termination, suspension, priority management, and exception handling.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Implements cross-platform thread management including creation, control, and lifecycle handling.

methods.name: Thread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and starts a thread with optional stack size and name.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread (Linux-specific).

methods.name: StartThread
methods.description: Static method to start thread execution, handling platform-specific thread startup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes thread resources, default implementation returns success.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Stops and joins the thread, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends thread execution (POSIX) or sets suspended state.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for thread to reach specified state within timeout.
